locations.label: Grief Pack-a-Punch outside Church
locations.description: In Grief, use the town streets, Saloon and Courthouse to move between buildings. Pack-a-Punch is outside in front of the Church and mansion and costs 5,000. There is no mansion crossing, maze route or Arthur barrier task. Approach the upgrade machine only when the lane behind you is clear. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Church Quick Revive
locations.description: Jugger-Nog is in its alley, Speed Cola in General Store, Mule Kick upstairs in Gunsmith, Double Tap on the mansion porch Stamin-Up between Courthouse and Church, and Quick Revive inside the Church where Buried has Vulture Aid. Vulture Aid is unavailable. Buy a core survival setup before investing in an extra Mule Kick weapon. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Ready-made device tables
locations.description: Assignments vary between the Courthouse, Saloon and upstairs table beside Sheriff’s Office. This is not a guaranteed active device pin. Three ready-built devices are distributed between the Courthouse table, Saloon table and upstairs table beside the Sheriff’s Office: Turbine, Trample Steam and Subsurface Resonator. Check all three because their table assignments vary. A Resonator needs a nearby Turbine to work. There are no parts to assemble and no Head Chopper here. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
